era: 2019 cvs.com desktop (late 2018 to 2020): white header with the red-heart CVS pharmacy logo, Pharmacy / MinuteClinic / Shop / ExtraCare / Contact Lenses / Photo, a Search box with a red magnifier, Easy Reorder and Basket; red #cc0000 square buttons and black bold Helvetica headings. Arquivo.pt only holds the 'not available outside the United States' page for 2019, the Wayback Machine, archive.ph and the Library of Congress archive did not load from the cloud or from Chrome, and no dated 2019 search-results or product-page screenshot was found; the sources are a November 2018 article, a CVS designer's portfolio and a January 2020 review showing the same design. cvs.com blocks headless browsers on search and product pages, so only the home page was inventoried; features without a 2019 source are left visible and marked unproven.
